purpose: Audit the deterministic geometry of the already-frozen locked safety gate before any v2 candidate-performance statistic is generated. This artifact changes no endpoint, sample size, threshold, candidate, or promotion rule.

derived.proof: For fixed n=5000, the Wilson upper endpoint is monotone in the observed success count over the relevant range. The point-estimate gate permits only k<=50, and at its largest permitted count the Wilson upper endpoint is 0.013158575092209418<0.015. Therefore every outcome that passes the point-estimate gate also passes the frozen Wilson-upper gate. At k=51 the Wilson-upper condition still passes, but the point-estimate condition already fails.

conference_interpretation.required_language: Report both frozen safety conditions exactly as preregistered, but do not describe the 0.015 Wilson-upper condition as an additional effective rejection barrier at n=5000; under the frozen sample size it is non-binding relative to the 0.01 point-estimate cap.
conference_interpretation.future_design_note: A later independently preregistered study that wants an uncertainty condition to add information should choose its count, point-estimate cap, and interval cap jointly by prospective operating-characteristic analysis. Do not retrofit v2 after observing outcomes.
